name: models_explore
description: Find generation models. Use recommend with goal + input context; use get for model constraints.

query.description: Model/use-case query; include input context like text-only, reference image, image-to-video, or product URL.

type.description: Filter by output type (omit to include all)

input.description: Input filter: image = accepts reference media; text = text-only.

limit.description: Max results, default 20 for list/search, 5 for recommend

after.description: Pagination cursor (next_page_token from a previous list/search result; not used by recommend)
